queries.name: table_sorted_desc

queries.dql: LIST FROM #work

queries.name: list_with_format
queries.dql: LIST priority FROM "Projects" WHERE priority >= 2 SORT priority

queries.name: from_incoming_link
queries.dql: LIST FROM [[Alpha]]

queries.name: from_outgoing_link

queries.dql: LIST FROM "Projects" AND -#home

queries.name: from_or
queries.dql: LIST FROM #urgent OR #home

queries.name: from_single_file
queries.dql: LIST FROM "Projects/Beta"

queries.name: sort_two_keys
queries.dql: TABLE status FROM "Projects" SORT status ASC, priority DESC

queries.name: limit
queries.dql: LIST FROM "Projects" SORT priority DESC LIMIT 2

queries.dql: TABLE length(rows) AS n, rows.file.name AS names FROM "Projects" GROUP BY status

queries.dql: TABLE sum(rows.priority) AS total FROM "Projects" GROUP BY status SORT key DESC

queries.name: flatten_with_where
queries.dql: TABLE WITHOUT ID file.name AS Note, t FROM "Projects" FLATTEN tags AS t WHERE t = "work"

queries.dql: TABLE due FROM "Projects" WHERE due AND due < date(2024-03-01)

queries.name: dateformat_luxon
queries.dql: TABLE dateformat(due, "yyyy/MM/dd") AS d FROM "Projects" WHERE due SORT due

queries.name: contains_on_a_list
queries.dql: LIST FROM "Projects" WHERE contains(tags, "urgent")
